name: Blessed Missionary (Sphere Archetype)
body:
The following archetype is designed for use with the Spheres of Power, Spheres of Might, and Spheres of Guile alternate rules. If not using Spheres, disregard these archetypes!

Casting: The blessed missionary may combine spheres and talents to create magical effects. The blessed missionary is considered a Mid-Caster. (Note: All casters gain 2 bonus talents and a casting tradition the first time they gain the casting class feature.) This replaces the spells class feature.

Spell Pool: The blessed missionary gains a small reservoir of energy they can call on to create truly wondrous effects, called a spell pool. This pool contains a number of spell points equal to their level + their casting ability modifier (minimum 1). This pool replenishes once per day after roughly 8 hours of rest.

Magic Talents: A blessed missionary gains 3/4ths of a magic talent at every level (the same progression as they gain caster levels).

Domain Sphere (Ex)

At 1st level, the blessed missionary may choose two spheres they possess to be their domain spheres. They use their class level as their caster level with these spheres. This stacks with other caster levels normally. This replaces fervor. Abilities that require fervor can be activated by spending an equal amount of spell points instead.
